shadowSentences: I love to read books every night.
The sky is so beautiful at sunset.
She enjoys cooking new recipes on weekends.
We went hiking in the mountains last summer.
He often listens to music while studying.
They always celebrate their birthdays with friends.
My favorite vacation was a trip to Japan.
Learning a new language can be both fun and challenging.
Traveling helps me experience different cultures firsthand.
Keeping a journal has improved my writing skills significantly.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you think travel influences personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles in maintaining a workout routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is regular exercise for health?
Q4: What tips would you suggest for someone starting to exercise?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteer experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a time when you volunteered?
Q2: What difficulties did you encounter while volunteering?
Q3: What are your thoughts on the impact of volunteer work in communities?
Q4: How would you encourage others to get involved in volunteering?
